purpose: Compile deterministic inspectable 3D scene state into a self-contained coded WebGL2 visual runtime, with an explicit bridge into Blender for deeper authoring and proof.

properties.scene: AXM native visual scene object; required for compile and bundle
properties.path: caller-selected output directory outside the protected live machine body; required for bundle and demo

contains: native-scene contract consumable by the Blender pro bridge

relationships: adds a fast coded visual execution path beside Blender rather than replacing Blender
shares camera, transforms, basic material values, lights and world state with tools/blender/axm_blender_pro.py
keeps browser pixel observation separate from deterministic source compilation and JavaScript syntax evidence
refuses silent writes into non-empty output directories unless replace is explicit
limitations: the native renderer currently supports boxes, spheres, cylinders and planes rather than arbitrary imported meshes
WebGL2 execution and rendered visual quality require browser or authorized host evidence
the Blender bridge preserves shared scene intent but does not claim pixel parity between renderers
final high-detail asset authoring, rigging, export and artifact-bound visual proof remain Blender-forge responsibilities

truth.basis: Compiled scene state, hashes, generated source, absent host pixels and Blender visual acceptance remain explicitly distinguishable.

agency.basis: The caller selects the operation, scene, output path and replacement choice; the runtime is self-contained and makes no network calls.

continuity.basis: The scene JSON is deterministic, inspectable and portable between the coded runtime and the additive Blender bridge.

wisdom-before-speed.basis: Schema validation, bounded scene size, deterministic hashing, source checks and explicit host evidence gates precede visual-quality claims.
